website_summary.name: Medical Journal Hub
website_summary.description: The website features a clean, user-friendly interface with a seashell background and crimson accents, designed for easy navigation and information discovery.
website_summary.appearance: The website has a minimalist design with a seashell background color (#fff5f5) and crimson elements for contrast. The top section includes a header with the website's logo ("Medical Journal") and a user profile button for Dr. Smith. Below the header, there is a search bar for finding articles. The main content area is divided into sections: "Featured Articles" and "Browse by Category." The "Featured Articles" section displays three articles in a grid layout, each with an image, title, description, date, and relevant hashtags. The "Browse by Category" section lists categories like Oncology, Cardiology, and Psychiatry, each with the number of articles available. The layout is responsive, adapting to different screen sizes.
website_summary.functionality: The website includes a search bar that allows users to search for articles by entering keywords. Users can browse featured articles and categories, each linking to detailed article pages. There is an "Add Article" button for contributors to submit new content. Users can manage their profiles through the user profile button. Additionally, the website supports downloading articles in PDF format, though this feature is not explicitly shown in the screenshots.
